# mv: convert function to method (funcToMethod path)
mv F T.M
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F(t T, x int) int {
	return t.X + x
}

func G() int {
	var t T
	return F(t, 1)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,11 +2,11 @@

 type T struct{ X int }

-func F(t T, x int) int {
+func (t T) M(x int) int {
 	return t.X + x
 }

 func G() int {
 	var t T
-	return F(t, 1)
+	return t.M(1)
 }
